text: dsh-workspace-overview 是 DSH Web 工作区界面插件，在聊天旁添加 Workspace Overview 标签，并提供接口让其他插件注册、排序和切换子标签；内置概览目前为空。它读取当前工作区的 .git/config 识别 GitHub 远程仓库，并可从会话标题打开仓库。适合集中查看工作区插件页面或快速访问项目仓库。需要 DSH Web 和 dsh-granular-settings，不需 API 密钥。

dsh-workspace-overview adds a DSH web tab for ordered subtabs from other plugins; its built-in page is empty. It reads workspace Git config for a GitHub remote and links to it from the session header. Requires dsh-granular-settings; no API key is declared.
我想把其他插件提供的工作区页面集中放在聊天旁边的标签里。
能不能在当前会话标题旁边直接打开这个工作区对应的 GitHub 仓库？
让不同插件能向一个工作区概览页注册并切换各自的子页面。
dsh-workspace-overview 的功能「工作区子标签页」：在聊天旁添加 Workspace Overview 页面，其他插件可注册并排序自己的子标签，用户点击标签即可切换内容；内置概览目前显示空状态。
dsh-workspace-overview 的功能「GitHub 仓库入口」：根据当前工作区的 .git/config 查找 GitHub 远程地址，并在会话标题旁显示仓库按钮；点击后在新标签页打开对应仓库。

dsh-workspace-overview README · dsh-workspace-overview：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: a Workspace Overview tab beside Chat.

The Overview page itself is an empty state, but the tab is a **subtab
host**: other plugins contribute tabs through the `workspaceOverview`
facade (`registerTab({id,label,order}, Component)`), the same shape as
`granularSettings.registerTab`.

dsh-workspace-overview README · dsh-workspace-overview：Also working: a **GitHub pill** in the session header when the current
workspace's `.git` config points at github.com. Clicking it opens the
repository in a new tab; visibility is the "GitHub pill in session header"
toggle in the Plugin tab of Granular Settings (default on).

dsh-workspace-overview README · How to install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout and a profile, here `web`. Clone the
dependencies and this plugin into a plugins folder:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/dsh-plugins && cd ~/dsh-plugins
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-granular-settings.git
git clone https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-workspace-overview.git

dsh-workspace-overview README · from the harness checkout：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-granular-settings
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add ~/dsh-plugins/dsh-workspace-overview

dsh-workspace-overview README · verify the profile still composes：pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart the harness; the tab appears beside Chat.

dsh-workspace-overview README · Dependencies：- [dsh-granular-settings](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-granular-settings) owns the "GitHub pill in session header" toggle this plugin registers and reads (required; the plugin does not activate without it)

dsh-workspace-overview README · Plugins dependent on this：- [dsh-workspace-history](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-workspace-history) contributes a History subtab listing the workspace's compaction journal
- [dsh-wo-github](https://github.com/joao-paulo-santos/dsh-wo-github) contributes a GitHub subtab with the About card, README, and commit history
